written: 2026-11-09, before final training and before any test-set evaluation
primary_metric: RMSE in cycles on the 100 official FD001 test engines, true RUL capped at 125 (same target definition as training)
complementary_metrics: PHM08 asymmetric score (penalises late predictions more)
RMSE against uncapped true RUL (reported for transparency)
prediction_post_processing: Predictions clipped below at 0 cycles for every model
seed_reporting: Individual seeds and mean +- standard deviation; no seed is selected using test results

stress_tests.sensor_noise: Add Gaussian noise N(0, sigma^2) to the min-max-scaled test inputs, sigma in {0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10}; 5 noise draws per sigma (numpy seed 123); all 3 seeds of every model; report mean test RMSE
stress_tests.subgroup: Split the 100 test engines at the median observed history length into short and long histories; report RMSE per group with group sizes

error_analysis: Inspect the 5 test engines with the largest absolute error and 5 engines near the median error, for the recommended model (seed-mean prediction)
inference_timing: CPU, single process, batch sizes 1 and 100, median of 50 timed repeats after 5 warm-up calls
